newsitem.title: UK: "Shine" pianist Helfgott tops UK charts.
newsitem.headline: "Shine" pianist Helfgott tops UK charts.

text.p: Australian pianist David Helfgott, whose heart-rending story is told in the Oscar-nominated film "Shine," went to the top of the British classical music charts on Tuesday with the only record he has ever made.

The 50-year-old pianist, who spent years in psychiatric institutions, topped the Australian charts for five months and is also number one in the U.S. with his recording of Rachmaninov's notoriously difficult Third Piano Concerto.
Helfgott is now on a world tour that has proved to be a sellout in both the United States and Britain.
Peter Feuchtwanger, who is now working with Helfgott, said: "He is like the great pianists of the past; always motivated and never mechanical."
"In a world full of dull young players who all sound the same, Helfgott makes the piano sing. He is as good as any other pianist alive today."
